semantic_insights: The record distinguishes released quantities, historical snapshots and anticipated targets instead of collapsing them into one dataset state.
Admission counts are not equated with unique patient counts, and image counts are not equated with admissions containing radiology data.
Prospective sampling, labeling, de-identification and holdout statements remain explicitly prospective or incomplete.
The public-availability goal is presented as an aspiration alongside the documented controlled-access state, avoiding an unsupported unrestricted-access claim.
The GitHub project's MIT license is explicitly kept separate from dataset licensing.
Named standards and validated mapping resources provide meaningful interoperability evidence, while the record still lacks release-specific lineage and reproducibility details.
All applicability predicates remain unknown because no independent caller declarations were supplied; no scoring item is excluded.
